title: After husband’s death, she ensured their 215 acres stay protected
summary_full: Becky Shelton made a conscious decision to prioritize land preservation over lucrative offers from developers. By securing her properties in King George and Stafford with legal protections, she ensures these areas remain untouched for future custodians. Shelton views her role as a temporary steward of the earth, taking action to prevent the encroachment of subdivisions and data centers on the natural landscape.
